headline: Suncor Energy Beats Profit Estimates on Higher Oil Prices and Margins
summary: Suncor Energy posted a profit that beat analyst estimates, supported by higher oil prices and improved operating margins.
why: Suncor Energy is a prominent Canadian integrated energy enterprise involved in oil sands development, refining, and petroleum marketing.

impacts.name: Suncor Energy
impacts.why: Surpassing profit forecasts typically drives positive momentum for a company's stock price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger realized commodity prices and enhanced refining margins directly translated into higher-than-expected net earnings.
